pilotBalance.reason: Each matching pilot stat is normalized against the equal-investment expected allied mean; NG+ recalculates from inherited allied levels and training.

scriptedStatPolicy.reason: Former JEPA barrier inference 129/130 is replaced by the normalized pilot reference; damage/barrier/event behavior remains. Ordinary transient stat effects still apply after the baseline.

calculation.method: Static arithmetic only; no combat/AI/sim is executed.
calculation.ordinaryFundingRule: A permanent optional member receives the same 48,310-credit allocation through remaining ordinary clear rewards, not an optional event reward. No retries, selling, gacha or hidden pickups counted.
fullClearCaveats: Episode 4 Grok is recruited, not killed.
Episode 6 Qwen is player-killed only on joined route; a third-faction kill grants the player no money.
Episode 13: two rival kills, two forced withdrawals, invulnerable Pico excluded.
Finite declared reinforcements included; no infinite farming.
calculation.expectedLevelMethod: Stage minimumLevel (1,3,...29) as analytic expected level; no extra hit, support grinding or retries. Training from required kills divided equally among available primary pilots, then equally six stats; locked stat share waits until unlock.
